title: Require Narrow Game Ui Bridge Bootstrap
forbids: UI bootstrap importing the control service or client/server RPC primitives instead of the mod-owned controller entrypoint
why: The bridge mod owns Civ7 controller realization; its UI bootstrap must install that realization without reaching through the service boundary.
remediate: Import and install through the mod-owned controller/game-ui entrypoint only.
message: Civ7 intelligence bridge UI bootstrap crossed the game-ui boundary.
